questions.prompt: What should you do if exam tab sharing stops?
options: Refresh the page and continue without sharing
questions.explanation: Quizeit pauses the exam when sharing stops. Share the same tab again to continue.

questions.prompt: Record a short introduction. Say what you want to practice and name one goal for your next study session.
questions.explanation: Mark the response correct if the recording includes a practice topic and a clear study goal.
